steps.name: Step 1 — Navigate to Agent Hub and capture the pre-search baseline
Step 2 — Click into the search bar at the top
Step 3 — Type a partial search term ('story') into the field
Step 4 — Verify exactly one debounced network request fired with query=story, no Enter/submit control involved
Step 5 — Verify only matching agents are displayed (e.g., 'User Story Creator')
Step 6 — Clear the search field and verify all agents return to the list
